title: DECODEM: Data Extraction from Corporate Organizational Documents via Enhanced Methods
abstract: arXiv:2607.15879v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Much empirical legal research depends on translating unstructured text into structured variables. In corporate governance research as elsewhere, this translation has traditionally been performed by humans. Manual coding is time-consuming and costly. In corporate governance research, standardized commercial datasets offer an alternative, but they cover a limited set of firms and governance variables.   This paper introduces the DECODEM Benchmarks and uses them to evaluate whether large language models can extract corporate governance variables from charters and bylaws. The benchmarks combine a sample of corporate charters and bylaws of publicly traded U.S. corporations obtained from the SEC's EDGAR database with hand-coded labels that capture whether a document includes a specific governance arrangement. translated_title: DECODEM：通过增强方法从公司组织文件中提取数据
translated_abstract: 许多实证法学研究依赖于将非结构化文本转换为结构化变量。在公司治理研究及其他领域，这种转换传统上由人工完成，而人工编码既耗时又昂贵。在公司治理研究中，标准化商业数据集提供了一种替代方案，但其覆盖的公司范围和治理变量种类有限。本文介绍了DECODEM基准测试，并利用这些基准评估大型语言模型能否从公司章程和章程细则中提取公司治理变量。该基准测试将由SEC的EDGAR数据库获取的美国上市公司章程和章程细则样本，与手工编码的标签相结合，这些标签用于标注文档中是否包含特定的治理安排。论文利用这些基准测试评估了一系列提取方法和模型，这些方法在多个维度上各不相同。
tldr: 本文提出DECODEM基准测试，利用SEC EDGAR数据库中的上市公司章程及章程细则样本与人工标注标签，系统评估大型语言模型提取公司治理变量的能力，为耗时昂贵的人工编码和覆盖有限的商业数据集提供了新的替代方案。
